# asset-style-check

Purpose: Verify chosen assets share visual style (realism, detail, color treatment) before scene build; flag style drift between assets early.

Catch style mismatches between assets before they end up in the same scene where the inconsistency reads as compositing error.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `asset-and-sourcing` | Role `cross-asset-visual-coherence-validator` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- after `asset-license-checker` clears the assets
- before scene build
- when a scene preview shows visible style mismatch
- when assets come from multiple sources
- Trigger phrases: "do these assets fit together", "style check the assets", "scene feels like a collage"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- single isolated asset where no multi-asset or scene-brief consistency check is requested → use `asset-discovery` (`references/skill-asset-discovery.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-discovery)
- pure planning before candidate assets are picked → use `asset-discovery` (`references/skill-asset-discovery.md`; use asset-discovery)
- intentionally mixed-style art direction, ONLY when the locked brief explicitly specifies mixed styles → use `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to asset-license-checker)
- checking asset licenses (asset-license-checker), polygon/performance budgets (polycount-budget-checker), topology, or planning materials/lighting (blender-light → use `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`; lighting-material-plan)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `candidate_asset_list` (`array`): Sourced 3D models, materials, and props to evaluate for visual coherence
- Required input `brief_style_direction` (`string`): Pinned visual style, proportion language, texel density, and surface wear target from brief
- Optional input `hero_anchor_asset` (`string`): Primary hero asset used as the visual benchmark for secondary props
- Output contract: `style_coherence_matrix`, `mismatched_asset_flags`, `remediation_or_fallback_recommendations` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. list every asset planned for the scene
2. evaluate each on style axes (realism / detail / color / surface)
3. flag drift between assets
4. recommend remediation (drop / restyle / replace)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Validation-only skill — never modifies or re-styles assets, and never executes Blender or Python. Per-asset verdicts (`Pass | Warn | Fail`) and drift classifications (`None | Minor | Major`) are derived solely from documented asset previews and the locked style brief, and are tracked separately from runtime/artifact truth states (which default to `Not Produced` for artifacts and are downgrade-only).
- Never modify or re-style assets.
- Never check asset licenses (belongs to `asset-license-checker`).
- Never check polycount budgets or mesh topology (belongs to `polycount-budget-checker`).
- Never execute Blender or Python code.
